summary: Product-update notification feature (iter38). Backend: 17/18 pytest pass (tests/test_pgs_iter38_product_notify.py, run with -n 0, 3 /run calls used). Verified: inventory restock pgs-9957 0->5 -> 1 pending 'restock' event -> /run creates 1 bell notification per customer (261) titled '<name> tersedia lagi', link /product/pgs-9957, demo sees it; opt-out user (notif_product=false) gets none; new product + price-only editor edit + variant price edit -> ONE digest 'Update produk: 2 harga berubah, 1 produk baru' with link /product-updates/{id}; detail returns change texts ('Produk baru', 'Harga turun Rp10.000 → Rp8.000', 'Harga variasi diperbarui'); unknown id 404, no auth 401; /run with nothing pending -> sent:false; inactive product create/edit emits no events; price-only editor save emits only 'price' (no spurious 'info'); admin endpoints 403 for buyer; settings defaults true and PUT/GET persist. One failure: deactivating a product while changing its price in the same save still emits a 'price' event. Frontend: /notifications Produk tab (notif-tab-product) lists both product notifications; tapping digest opens /product-updates/{id} with pu-item-* rows, tapping a row opens /product/{id}; tapping single notification opens /product/pgs-9957; /account/settings toggles set-notif-product and set-email-product switch, persist to API and survive reload.

minor.issue: If a product is switched to inactive and its price/stock changes in the same save, history.record() is called with the OLD (active) product, so product_notify.on_history emits a 'price'/'stock' event and buyers get notified about a hidden product (tapping it shows 'Produk tidak ditemukan'). Fix: in on_history (or callers) pass the merged/new doc, or skip when the new status is inactive. Ref: product_editor.py:416, product_bulk.py:219, product_notify.py:62

email result counts demo@pgs.id (fake domain, blocked as undeliverable_recipient 400) as 'failed' every run -> {'sent':1,'failed':1}. Expected in preview, but you could count undeliverable separately so admin isn't misled.

SettingsIn fields all default True and the whole settings doc is replaced; an older client sending only the 3 original fields would silently re-enable notif_product/email_product. Consider $set of only provided fields (exclude_unset).

ui_bugs.issue: Digest list keeps items whose product was later deactivated/deleted; tapping leads to 'Produk tidak ditemukan'. Consider marking/hiding unavailable items.

issues: Switch elements set-notif-product / set-email-product are 40x20 px (below 44pt) - make the whole row pressable if it isn't
Filter tab pills (notif-tab-*) are 34 px tall (<44pt)

action_items: Do not emit price/stock events when the same save makes the product inactive (pass the new doc / new status to history.record -> product_notify.on_history).
Optional: filter inactive/deleted products from GET /api/product-updates/{id} items or mark them unavailable in the UI.
Optional: PUT /me/settings should merge only provided fields.
critical_code_review_comments: run_digest loads all customers (to_list(100000)) and inserts one notification per customer each digest (261 docs now) - OK at this scale; ensure index on notifications(user_id, created_at).
send_emails is sequential per user inside the admin request; with many verified users /run will become slow (HTTP timeout risk). Consider running it in a background task.
Events claimed via update_many + modified_count protects against double send; good.

rca_of_issue: Hidden-product notification: product_editor.publish calls history.record(db, user, store, old, snap(old), snap({**old, **doc})) -> on_history(db, product=old, ...) -> _visible(old) is True, so price change emits an event even though doc.status == 'inactive'. Repro: edit active product, set status inactive + new price, publish -> db.product_events gets kind 'price'.
